seoTitle: Very Black Friday 2026: Dates, Deals & Price Promise
title: Very Black Friday 2026: dates and the best deals so far
description: Very's Black Friday 2026 sale runs 2 November to 4 December. The best deals live now, the EXTRA 10% code, its price promise and returns.
intro:
**Very's Black Friday 2026 sale is live: it started on Monday 2 November and ends on Friday 4 December.** The best deal we found today is still the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo bean-to-cup coffee machine at £349, within £5 of its lowest ever price, and until 18 November code **EXTRA** takes another 10% off selected Black Friday products.

Very's Black Friday Price Promise also means you can claim the difference if it cuts the price of an eligible item again before 4 December. Some 'was' prices are still generous, so compare before you buy. Last checked: 14 November 2026.

body:
## When does Very Black Friday 2026 start?

Very's Black Friday page confirms the 2026 sale **started on Monday 2 November and ends on Friday 4 December**. That's longer than most retailers, and it carries on past Cyber Monday (30 November). Very says some extra deals will drop on Black Friday itself (27 November) and that weekend, and it also runs short 'Flash Deals' that end at midnight.

In 2025, Very's sale was also early: its Black Friday deals were already live and reported by 1 November 2025. See our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for other retailers' dates.

## Very's EXTRA code: 10% off until 18 November

Until 18 November 2026, code **EXTRA** takes an extra 10% off selected Black Friday products. It doesn't apply to insurance, delivery or installation, and you can't combine it with another code. Very doesn't say which items qualify on product pages, so add the item to your basket and apply the code to see if it works.

## What's on at Very right now

On 14 November, all the deals we listed on 8 November were still live at the same prices. Very's deals are strongest on TVs, coffee machines, air fryers and perfume. New since our last check: the Sage Barista Express at £479, the Dyson V8 Cyclone at £239 and the DKNY Be Delicious Fresh Blossom 100ml perfume at £25. On 8 November we also saw the Ninja Combi SFP700UK at £179, the Ninja Double Stack XL SL451UK at £198, the Shark NV603UK upright at £129, the Oral-B Vitality Pro at £24 and the stainless steel Sage Barista Express at £499 (still the same today).

Prices move around. Some early deals we listed in October have gone back up: the Ninja Luxe Café Premier is now £549, the Shark Stratos IZ400UKT £449 and the Remington S8500 straightener £79.99. Price trackers such as PriceSpy are worth a 30-second check before you buy.

## Very's Black Friday Price Promise (new for 2026)

On 29 October, Very announced a Black Friday Price Promise covering every category. It runs from 28 October to 4 December 2026:

- if Very lowers the price of an eligible Black Friday item later in the event, you can claim the difference
- it only covers Very's own price cuts, not other shops' prices
- promo codes, short Flash Deals, vouchers, bundles, multi-buys and personalised offers are excluded
- you claim by phone on 0800 11 00 00, by 4 December

## Very's everyday Price Promise

Separately, Very matches lower prices on its electrical and toy ranges. The terms on its product pages say:

- it matches Argos, Currys, Smyths, The Entertainer, AO and John Lewis, using their advertised website price
- you claim by phone within 7 days of buying from Very
- the item must be identical, in stock elsewhere, and the lower price must still be live when Very checks
- it won't match prices that need a discount code, membership, cashback or finance offer
- DIY tools, personal care and sports equipment are excluded

Amazon isn't on the list, so neither promise helps if Amazon is cheaper.

## Christmas returns

Very has confirmed its 2026 Christmas returns. **Gifts bought from 1 October to 10 December 2026 can be returned until 8 January 2027**, as long as they're complete, unused and in their original packaging. Christmas trees and decorations are excluded. Anything bought from 11 December falls back to the usual 28 days.

Returns are free under Very's 28-day approval guarantee, through drop-off points or home collection.

## Delivery costs

- **Standard delivery:** £3.99, free on orders of £75 or more (usually 3 to 5 days)
- **Next day or nominated day:** £5.99
- **Click & Collect:** £3, free on orders of £30 or more; next-day collection is £4.99
- **Large items (TVs, appliances, furniture):** charged separately, from £8.99 to £34.99 for standard delivery

Very also sells on credit through its own account. You don't need it to get any of the sale prices on this page; you can pay by card as normal.

## What was cheap at Very last Black Friday

These are Very's early Black Friday prices in 2025, as reported on 1 November 2025. They give a rough idea of what to expect, though this year's models and prices will differ:

- Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer air fryer: £198 (was £269)
- Dyson V11 Extra: £349 (was £499)
- Hisense A6Q 55-inch 4K TV: £269 (was £499)
- PS5 Digital Edition + EA FC 26 bundle: £399
- Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle: £409
- Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones: £249
- Apple Watch Series 10: £269 (was £399)

Very is strongest on TVs, small appliances, vacuums and toys. For brand target prices, see our [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) guides, or compare with [Argos Black Friday 2026](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) and [Currys Black Friday 2026](/guides/currys-black-friday-2026/).

### When does the Very Black Friday sale start in 2026?

It started on Monday 2 November and ends on Friday 4 December, so it's live now.

### Does Very price match Amazon?

No. Its Price Promise covers electricals and toys and matches Argos, Currys, Smyths, The Entertainer, AO and John Lewis, but not Amazon.

### Can I return Very Christmas presents in January?

Yes, if you buy between 1 October and 10 December 2026. Those orders can be returned until 8 January 2027 if they're unused and in their original packaging.

### Is delivery free at Very?

Standard delivery is free on orders of £75 or more; under that it's £3.99. Click & Collect is free over £30. Large items always cost extra.

### Are Very's Black Friday deals worth it?

Some are, especially on TVs, coffee machines and air fryers, and the new Price Promise protects you if Very cuts the price again. But some 'was' prices are inflated, so compare with Amazon and other shops, and check our [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) page for target prices.
